The four XML-pair disputes remain recorded as unresolved in the supplied investigation, without identified disagreeing dimensions. The proposal distinguishes the circular's supported statement of the duty from the missing schema needed to assess substantive conformity; it does not assert that prior disagreement has been resolved.

Footnote 3 is anchored to both XML and prescribed-PDF submissions in da12aecad4e68.u4.1003 and da12aecad4e68.u5.1078. The extraction's absent-anchor uncertainty is stale. Extending e-Cert to every submission method is unsupported; absence of an anchor on the web form also does not establish a general exemption from requirements outside this packet.

For node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098, the exact executable condition is "[the fact filing_date] is greater than or equal to [date value 2026-02-02]". It includes other-channel filings before 9:00am that day. The source separately states "With effect from 2 February 2026" in da12aecad4e68.u3.811 and "upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026" in da12aecad4e68.u13.2131. Preserve competing readings of "following its implementation" rather than treating the date-only and operational-launch candidates as equivalent.

The operational-launch candidates select an inclusive 9:00am boundary. The launch provisions support that interpretation, but the resubmission passage does not expressly settle exact-boundary inclusion or the governing timezone. What authoritative JFIU clarification or time convention establishes the governing timezone and resolves the implementation boundary? That additional authority is absent and cannot be mapped to any supplied dependency ID.

The urgent-contact provision in da12aecad4e68.u12.1941 applies during the blackout. It does not establish that every email, call or fax is an actual STR submission, or create a general post-launch alternative-channel permission. Likewise, automatic migration under da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 does not by itself establish a new submission event.

No quoted trigger provision makes account registration, XML-schema conformity or e-Cert use a prerequisite to triggering resubmission. Adding those conditions would impose unsupported restrictions on the trigger. Their absence from a trigger formula does not establish compliance with the separate submission requirements.

The surrounding XML provision also requires firms to liaise with JFIU as soon as possible to arrange a technical test. That separate action is outside these trigger questions; the schema claim is supported as an atomic extraction but is not an exhaustive account of da12aecad4e68.u14.2439.

Actual STR filing appears in the scope of nodes node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098, node.8c5e0d91275b795d477f7913 and node.8caddb7a4c29338c1d340db1, whereas node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb places submission in its result. For a licensed actor's nonfiling event, these can produce OUT_OF_SCOPE versus FALSE. Their equivalence depends on whether the typed original-event domain already excludes nonfilings.

Node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3 delegates event existence, timing, channel classification and sufficient-history assessment to a supplied Boolean. Its exact executable result, "Result: the fact report_has_postlaunch_other_channel_submission", does not implement the existential search. An absent qualifying record in incomplete history must not become FALSE. Attribution to the report's responsible entity also needs examination where different entities made different submissions.

These are historical DUTY_TRIGGER questions. A later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase an earlier triggering event; conversely, a historical TRUE does not establish an outstanding duty or noncompliance. The declaration TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must be read consistently with the typed meaning of TRUE as trigger existence.

JFIU's promised resubmission guidance in da12aecad4e68.u28.3334 is missing and has no identifiable dependency mapping. Can that guidance and its applicable version be supplied for any assessment of resubmission performance or discharge? The source does not make publication of that guidance a prerequisite to the stated duty.

Every supplied external dependency has a null source_hash and lacks identifying metadata. No dependency can be classified AVAILABLE or safely matched to the XML schema, resubmission guidance or timezone authority. Source unit IDs belong in source evidence, not authority dependency_ids.

The runtime's UNKNOWN and CONFLICT rules remain distinct from legal triggering. Missing classifications must retain uncertainty under the declared semantics; a conflicting dependency blocks evaluation even where another operand might otherwise determine a Boolean result. These scoped checks do not independently validate that runtime policy.

units.text: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) issues this circular to inform licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”) about the logistical arrangements for transitioning to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit’s (JFIU) new suspicious transaction reporting platform by 2 February 2026.

The JFIU has developed the new platform, the Suspicious Transaction Report and Management System 2 (STREAMS 2)1, which will replace the current STREAMS platform. By enhancing system automation and analytical capabilities, the new platform increases the efficiency and effectiveness of the JFIU’s analysis and dissemination of financial intelligence gathered from suspicious transaction reports (STRs) received.
STR submission
With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2. Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
(a)  submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
(b)  uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
(c)  completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
STREAMS 2 account registration

Licensed firms should register STREAMS 2 user accounts to facilitate the prompt submission of STRs. For new user registration, please download the STREAMS 2 User Registration Form available on the JFIU website (https://www.jfiu.gov.hk/info/doc/STREAMS_2_Reg_form.docx), and submit the completed form to the JFIU via email (jfiu@police.gov.hk).
System transitional arrangements
Licensed firms should observe the JFIU’s transitional arrangements as set out below:

(a)  the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2 (hereafter referred to as the “blackout period of STREAMS”);
(b)  for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

(c)  upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, the operation of STREAMS will be discontinued. All STRs previously submitted through STREAMS will be migrated to STREAMS 2. Licensed firms will be able to access these records and, where applicable, view the consent status, via STREAMS 2; and

(d)  licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU and liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition.
Should you have any queries regarding the contents of this circular, please contact the JFIU’s Senior Inspector Mr Owen Tse at 3660 0533 or by email (owencytse@police.gov.hk).
Intermediaries Division
Securities and Futures Commission
End

1 STREAMS 2 was introduced by the JFIU during the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Webinar held on 17 and 18 November 2025. The presentation material is accessible on the SFC website
(https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/files/IS/AML/SFC-AMLCFT-Webinar-202511_JFIU_ENG.pdf?rev=

For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.
